steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each channel and campaign is matched to a baseline, a measure and an owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 targets need a baseline or a result

findings.title: Target with no baseline from last year
findings.fix: Record last year's result as the baseline

findings.title: Channel with no results behind it
findings.fix: Show the results or cut the channel

findings.title: Plan spend that does not match the total

outcome.notChecked: Market forecasts; commercial strategy beyond the notes given.
